description:
A pet goes missing. The neighbourhood should know in minutes, not days.

Sighting is a lost and found board for pets. Post an animal you lost, or one you found, with a photo and the place you last saw it. Everyone nearby sees it on the board and on the map.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Post a lost or found pet with a photo, species, colour, tag or chip number and a reward
- See every post on a list or a map, filtered by lost, found or species
- Search by name, colour, tag number or place
- Share a post, or print it as a pole poster
- Mark a post reunited when the pet is home

You do not need an account to post. Each post gets its own private edit link. Sign in with email or Apple if you want to manage your posts from any device.

Posts are public so neighbours can help. Any post can be reported, hidden, or its poster blocked from the menu on the post. Sighting has no ads and sells nothing.
keywords: lost pet,found pet,missing dog,missing cat,lost dog,lost cat,pet finder,neighbourhood,poster,reunite
promotionalText: Lost a pet, or found one? Post it with a photo and the neighbourhood sees it in minutes.
